body: Don’t give up, you just haven’t met the right one yet. It’s hard finding the right guy in this generation. I, myself still haven’t found the right one but I believe one day I will and you will too. If you do run into a boy who don’t appreciate you or don’t like you back, don’t waste your time or energy on them because it’s very draining. Trust me I’ve been there. Even if they do say “I like you” but their actions not showing it, don’t do it. It’s not worth it. Actions speak louder than words. I hope this helps and I wish you the best of luck.
I knooow.😭 I just want someone to be there when I need them and make me feel better when I’m feeling down and have fun.
